question: Arena size and layout. First build: four separate slabs around a small hub (range 42x17 m, course 38x20 m, pit 36x26 m, powers pad 38x15 m; about 80x55 m in all), real Rivet, D5 ink floor. Keep this layout, or change it?

options.label: Keep four slabs around a hub (as built)
options.tradeoff: each station is isolated and easy to read and measure; walking between stations takes 5-10 s

options.label: One open floor, stations as zones with low walls between them
options.tradeoff: closer to a city block (enemies can chase across zones); harder to measure one thing at a time

options.label: Keep the slabs, plus a dev key that teleports Rivet to any station
options.tradeoff: fastest to iterate in; one more dev key
